dialogue_texts: Oh my, how incredibly formal of you. Though if you truly understood whom you were speaking to, you would have known better than to stage this clumsy little rebellion.
You may have bested both of us, but the Order will live on under Flandre Scarlet's rule.
I know you are using her name for your desperate games.
The Crimsonite grunts will dance in the capital of your pathetic kingdom.
The eternal night is vast, and Gensokyo has a way of swallowing up noises that grow too loud. They will fade away, just like everything else.
Berenice and I are done for...
Indeed you are. It is time to bow out gracefully. The stage is no longer yours.
Thank you, My Majesty. The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo at this time is safe.
You are most welcome, Fusana. I am simply glad to see the peace maintained. Though I do expect your subordinates to neatly sweep away every trace of this Crimsonite dust.
I am very and truly pleased. I will attend the festival in Kozankyo.
It has been a while since I've enjoyed a proper celebration.
I am finally happy to be reunited with Fusana. With the Grieg sisters gone, their forest of thorns has disappeared.
A beautiful resolution. Thorns born of stolen hours can never withstand the true flow of time. I am genuinely happy to see the two of you reunited under the moonlight.
They can no longer alter their fate, nor even escape and return to their own time.
Eternity is not something to be trifled with by the desperate. Trying to rewrite history only traps you in a cage of your own making, frozen away from the present.
Using whatever time we have left, I can finally show you what our nights are like in the mansion.
Please enjoy your time together in the mansion.
As I remark on the romance between myself and Fusana, our private ball begins now.
